description: A sovereign personal knowledge management workspace. Capture everything, connect ideas, build your external brain.

profiles.description: Atomic knowledge units — your core thinking medium.
Captured passages from books, articles and web content.
Evergreen ideas and mental models you're building over time.
Memorable words worth preserving and revisiting.
Your reading library — track books, progress and insights.
People in your intellectual and professional world.
Bounded efforts with a defined outcome and timeline.
Ongoing domains of your life you want to maintain standards in.
Web articles and blog posts worth saving and processing.
Quick links to valuable resources and pages.
Raw sparks and early-stage thinking.
Intentions with a target state and measurable progress.
Video content from YouTube, courses, and other platforms.
Episodes and shows worth listening to or already consumed.
Events and experiences in your life timeline.
Places you've visited or want to visit.
Companies, institutions, and communities in your network.
Educational courses you're taking or have completed.
Newsletters you're subscribed to or tracking.
Voice recordings and their transcripts.
Open questions driving your curiosity and research.

properties.outcome: Have a fully functional PKM system capturing and connecting my knowledge.
